title: ServiceOutputs
description: Which outputs the service streams to: the JSON carried as a string in the `outputs` value of the `set-outputs` command (see command-request.schema.json). The service rejects the whole command (ok: false) if anything is invalid; otherwise it applies the settings right away and saves them, so they replace res/ambilight.json from the next start on. The HyperHDR image size isn't part of it and stays as it was.

Esp32OutputSettings.title: Esp32OutputSettings
Esp32OutputSettings.description: UDP output to the ESP32 controllers found by discovery. Discovery itself keeps running when this is off (it also finds tools/server.py for the event log).

HyperHdrOutputSettings.title: HyperHdrOutputSettings
HyperHdrOutputSettings.description: TCP output to a HyperHDR server's FlatBuffers input.

hyperhdrHost.description: IP address or host name of the HyperHDR machine; surrounding spaces are ignored. Must not be empty while `enabled` is true (not expressible in the schema; the service checks it).

hyperhdrPriority.description: HyperHDR shows the source with the lowest number; its own grabbers use 240/245.
